profile_text.body:
Twilio Inc. describes itself as a platform for customer engagement, offering APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, along with conversational AI and identity verification. The company says its platform connects communication channels, customer context, and AI to support interactions between humans and AI agents, with full context transferred when a human takes over.

On the AI side, Twilio positions its conversational AI for what it calls the agentic era. The company states that AI agents draw from internal knowledge and real-time data, and can decide when to bring in a human based on complexity or customer intent. It describes a toolkit for orchestrating context-rich conversations across channels.

Twilio is a for-profit public company traded under the ticker TWLO, with headquarters in San Francisco, CA, and CIK 0001447669. Records list 281 California law exposure entries for the company. It is also listed under the alias TWILIO INC - A.
